scope: Documented cartridge-runtime behavior for desktop ahead-of-time conversion to the current RP2040/Waveshare target, under explicit resource limits. Host/editor authoring tools and Splore are excluded. Runtime audio state remains in scope even without a speaker. A 100% checklist score does not imply all cartridges fit the RP2040 or run at their target frame rate.
weights_policy: Judgment-based importance weights, frozen at rubric v1. They are not measured engineering effort, remaining development time or probabilities that games work. Each category has a fixed weight and equally weighted acceptance entries within it. GUI/flashing tooling is reported separately and contributes zero to the core score.
status_policy: Supported means implemented within the stated gate with no specific missing behavior found by the audit; it does not mean independently reference-verified. Partial means a known limitation or incomplete acceptance gate. Missing includes silent no-ops. Evidence is local implementation/regression/device evidence unless explicitly reference-validated.

categories.name: Math, tables, strings and advanced Lua APIs

custom_features.name: Read self-contained .p8 source
custom_features.acceptance: Extract Lua and cartridge sections without executing or rewriting source.

custom_features.name: Read compressed .p8.png containers
custom_features.acceptance: Decode the frozen sample and a source/ROM-preserving positive control through pinned Shrinko8.

custom_features.name: Import sprite pixels
custom_features.acceptance: Unpack gfx nibbles into native ROM assets with dimension checks.

custom_features.name: Import map and sprite flags
custom_features.acceptance: Preserve map/flag bytes and expose them to the native runtime.

custom_features.name: Preserve shared sprite/map memory
custom_features.acceptance: mset/mget and sset/sget observe the overlapping lower sprite/map bytes.

custom_features.name: Source preservation and build provenance
custom_features.acceptance: Record original container and decoded-source hashes separately with generated code and firmware evidence.

custom_features.name: Cartridge version and malformed-input coverage
custom_features.acceptance: Validate documented cartridge versions and malformed sections/containers with systematic negative cases.

custom_features.name: Read raw .p8.rom cartridges
custom_features.acceptance: Accept full-size 32768-byte .rom/.p8.rom containers, optionally with a 32-byte trailer, through the shared text/PNG decode path. Code-only tiny ROMs and multi-cart exports are excluded.

custom_features.name: LCD-board physical button mapping
custom_features.acceptance: Read and debounce the nine known GPIO inputs and map the six PICO-8 gameplay buttons.

custom_features.name: Program init/update/draw callback lifecycle
custom_features.acceptance: Initialize and invoke normal _init/_update/_update60/_draw callbacks, including mutable callback values.

custom_features.name: 30/60 Hz scheduling and frame pacing
custom_features.acceptance: Match callback order, catch-up and time progression when the game or display cannot sustain its requested rate.

custom_features.name: Additional controller players
custom_features.acceptance: Return supported controller states for documented player indices instead of rejecting every nonzero player.

custom_features.name: Mouse/keyboard input adaptation
custom_features.acceptance: Adapt the documented mouse/keyboard enable and stat query behavior.

custom_features.name: Configurable held-button repeat
custom_features.acceptance: Honor documented repeat configuration rather than only the fixed default delay/rate.

custom_features.name: Decode SFX/music ROM assets
custom_features.acceptance: Preserve sound and pattern data from cartridge sections.

custom_features.name: Music/SFX sequencer timing
custom_features.acceptance: Advance patterns/notes/channel state with documented loop and stop behavior.

custom_features.name: Four-channel waveform synthesis
custom_features.acceptance: Produce documented channel sample waveforms and instruments.

custom_features.name: Audio effects and custom instruments
custom_features.acceptance: Implement note effects, envelopes and custom instruments.

custom_features.name: Audio state accessible to game code
custom_features.acceptance: Expose current pattern/note/channel state through the relevant stat queries.

custom_features.name: Stateful silent audio mode
custom_features.acceptance: With no attached speaker, still emulate audio sequencing and observable state instead of discarding sound calls.

custom_features.name: Native Arm compilation and linking
custom_features.acceptance: Turn generated C and the bounded support runtime into RP2040 firmware using an explicitly configured Pico SDK and Arm toolchain.

custom_features.name: UF2 packaging and flash bounds
custom_features.acceptance: Emit contiguous RP2040-family UF2 blocks and reject firmware beyond this board flash capacity.

custom_features.name: Standalone execution after flashing
custom_features.acceptance: Run the converted cartridge without a desktop game process, Lua VM or network service.

custom_features.name: Bounded allocations and runaway execution
custom_features.acceptance: Enforce explicit allocation, instruction and call-depth limits with controlled errors.

custom_features.name: Separate stacks and stack-use checks
custom_features.acceptance: Reserve nonoverlapping core stacks and reject oversized generated transitions using compiler evidence and runtime headroom checks.

custom_features.name: Runtime diagnostics and USB recovery
custom_features.acceptance: Report conversion/runtime errors and provide bootloader recovery from the known buttons/USB commands.

custom_features.name: Per-cartridge RAM/stack peak prediction
custom_features.acceptance: Predict peak live data and worst native call chain before deployment, rather than rely on bounded failures and linker/static-frame checks alone.

custom_features.name: Per-cartridge performance qualification
custom_features.acceptance: Measure logic/display timing and qualify the intended frame rate over representative play traces.

custom_features.name: Resource-aware game optimization
custom_features.acceptance: Reduce generated code/heap/stack costs sufficiently for a varied corpus, with measured fit decisions.

custom_features.name: Reproducible clean-machine toolchain bootstrap
custom_features.acceptance: Rebuild from a clean documented Linux installation with pinned complete host dependencies, SDK and compiler.

custom_features.name: Compiler/unit regression runner
custom_features.acceptance: Run recorded parser/compiler checks with the pinned Rust lockfile.

custom_features.name: Generated-native semantic and sanitizer runner
custom_features.acceptance: Execute actual generated C fixtures under ASan/UBSan, not just compare generated text.

custom_features.name: Controlled failure regression cases
custom_features.acceptance: Exercise runaway loops and bounded heap failure paths.

custom_features.name: Hardware frame/input/startup checks
custom_features.acceptance: Capture real-device frames/status and obtain owner confirmation for converted games.

custom_features.name: Broad unbiased game corpus coverage
custom_features.acceptance: Maintain a frozen diverse corpus with stage-by-stage results, enough breadth and traces to characterize compatibility.

custom_features.name: PICO-8 numeric/language differential oracle
custom_features.acceptance: Compare generated program outputs with a frozen official PICO-8 reference suite.

custom_features.name: Graphics/text/API overload golden results
custom_features.acceptance: Compare deterministic reference framebuffers and return values across graphics overloads.

custom_features.name: Audio-state/sample reference comparisons
custom_features.acceptance: Compare sequencer states and generated samples with reference vectors.

custom_features.name: Deterministic full-game input trace comparisons
custom_features.acceptance: Replay identical recorded input against reference and converted games and compare observable states/frames.

custom_features.name: Real Pico stress and sustained-frame benchmarks
custom_features.acceptance: Automate long-running resource, stack and frame-deadline benchmarks over varied game traces.

custom_features.name: Grid/list cartridge navigation and artwork fallback
custom_features.acceptance: Browse original-demo thumbnails or imported local artwork, search/filter/sort and inspect conversion failures.

custom_features.name: Desktop conversion/import workflow
custom_features.acceptance: Import a local cartridge and only add firmware after host checks and building succeed.

custom_features.name: Verified one-click flashing and startup checks
custom_features.acceptance: Validate firmware/hash/chip, enter BOOTSEL, transfer and verify startup.

custom_features.name: Saved originals and recovery workflow
custom_features.acceptance: Restore an optional user-provided, verified RP2040 recovery image; recovery is hidden when no image is configured.

custom_features.name: General GUI batch conversion workflow
custom_features.acceptance: Run batch selection/download/conversion and export detailed results from an easy desktop flow.

custom_features.name: Portable application installer
custom_features.acceptance: Install toolchain/helper/USB dependencies on a clean machine with a supported installer.

audit_notes: Dashboard integration: source hashes for GUI/flashing tooling are tracked separately from translator implementation.
Re-audit: host-only P8_API_PROFILE counters and JSON output added; native runtime behavior and supported/partial/missing capability statuses are unchanged.
Runtime/API name table moved to file scope to share immutable names with the optional host profiler. No device firmware was flashed during dashboard work.

Public-source review 2026-10-16: independently authored compact ASCII font replaces the historical font asset; text remains partial. Portable SDK/compiler discovery replaces private paths. The default sanitizer/PNG suite now uses only original fixtures; external game execution is historical. Compiler change is an inline original test-fixture replacement, with no translation-semantic change. Core statuses and rubric weights are unchanged.

2026-10-16: re-audited small API improvements with original generated-native assertions, seven new expected-error cases and an RP2040 fixture build. Four raw helpers and camera/cursor/palt gates are supported within the bounded model; select is partial. Other improved graphics gates stay partial. Scope, weights and historical evidence are unchanged. See docs/SMALL-GAPS.md.

Test isolation fix: GUI tests read CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR instead of launcher/executable discovery. Navigation checks current committed inventory rather than a frozen functional count; production behavior and core credit are unchanged.

Second small-gap pass: full-size raw ROM acceptance gate is supported after four original source/data/generated-C identity scenarios, 600 sanitized frames each, and eight malformed input rejections. Numeric/string APIs improved but retain partial limits; scope and weights unchanged. Numeric fixture built end-to-end from raw ROM to RP2040 UF2 without flashing.

Third small-gap batch: pal numeric previous state, table/reset subset, leading-dot radix source literals and bitwise function defaults improve existing gates. No complete gate changes status, so index remains52.2% with the same173 gates. Added three original fixtures plus palette/operator negative cases. No hardware flashing or reference-oracle claim.

Coverage pass 2026-10-16: services, input, audio-state, frontend and semantics gates re-audited after the memory/persistence/menu/flip, silent-audio, metatable, iterator, coroutine, vararg and goto work. Synthesis, effects, includes, upper memory and persistent saves remain open. Scope and weights are unchanged.
Coverage pass 2026-10-18: smaller generated stack frames, larger string/table/entry pools, ls/serial bindings and runtime-only load re-audited. Scope and weights unchanged.
evidence_policy: Historical external cartridge/build/hardware paths in test pointers are provenance from the private experiment and are not bundled. Fresh public execution is recorded separately in runtime-api-coverage.json; the historical profile is retained unchanged.
